# International Fire & Safety Journal

> > Global fire safety publication covering fire suppression systems, detection technologies, and emerging hazards including lithium-ion battery risks.

International Fire & Safety Journal provides professional news and insights on fire safety technologies, industry developments, and safety standards across global regions. The publication features coverage of leading manufacturers like Fomtec and Ajax Systems, innovations in foam technology and wireless detection systems, and critical safety challenges in the Americas and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Lithium-ion battery safety
- Fire suppression systems
- Fire detection technologies
- Foam technology
- Wireless fire safety systems
- Fomtec
- Ajax Systems
- SFFF (Scottish Fire and Rescue)
- Iain Hoey
- Americas fire safety
- Fire safety standards
- Emergency response
- Industrial fire protection

## Regional Fire Safety News

- [International Fire & Safety Journal | Fire Safety News](https://internationalfireandsafetyjournal.com/americas/): Fire safety news for Americas featuring Fomtec, Ajax Systems, lithium-ion
